branches.all-complete: verify stored readings and report COMPLETED
branches.conflict: re-read the capture revision and retry once with the current revision
branches.missing-field: store the reading with unresolvedReason and ask the scoped question (CLARIFYING)
branches.refused-span: stop with the field and reason (REFUSED), never guess

skills.completion: every distinct occurrence stored with exact span/amount/date/time, or a scoped clarification question
skills.error_recovery: Conflict retries once with fresh state; NeedsClarification becomes a user question, not a retry
triggers: user asks to save or record note occurrences

branches.error: stop with the provider/tool error, never fabricate rows
branches.nonempty-page: compare returned facts with the event before any link step

skills.completion: bounded page observed with limit/offset/reviewStatus stated; hasMore/nextOffset reported
skills.error_recovery: schema-invalid bounds are caller bugs, refused before dispatch
prerequisites: event or question needing draft evidence
triggers: user asks to find or compare bank drafts

branches.attach-refused: stop with ATTACH_POLICY and leave the pair proposed for the user
branches.conflict: re-read the link revision and retry once, else stop with the conflict
branches.no-match: report no candidate and stop with zero calls
branches.propose-ok-ambiguous: stop after propose and ask the scoped user question
branches.propose-ok-unique: attach with expectedRevision of the proposal

skills.completion: link in the expected state, or a scoped user question for an ambiguous pair
skills.error_recovery: Denied ATTACH_POLICY is terminal for the agent; Conflict retries once with fresh state
prerequisites: no active draft on the event unless re-proposing the same pair
triggers: user asks to connect a note occurrence to a bank draft

branches.over-budget: stop with REFUSED before inference; text never shortened
branches.prediction-stored: report the review-only suggestion with its scope, never as a ledger write
branches.safety-blocked: stop with a scoped refusal, never offer the text

skills.completion: stored review-only prediction, or a stated refusal (safety/over-budget)
skills.error_recovery: Failed/Conflict surfaces to the user; no silent fallback to another category
prerequisites: exact review description and its revision
triggers: user asks for a category suggestion for a draft
